Frequently Asked Questions
Q1. When did the NTA UGC NET December 2026 Online Application Process Start?
The online application process started on 08 October 2026 .
Q2. What is the Exam Date for NTA UGC NET December 2026?
The Examination will be conducted in 14- 19 December 2026
Q3. Where can I find the syllabus for the NTA UGC NET December 2026 Examination?
The detailed syllabus and examination scheme are available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully for complete details.
Q4. How can I download the NTA UGC NET December 2026 Notification PDF?
Candidates can download the notification through SarkariResult.com.
Q5. What is the last date to apply online for NTA UGC NET December 2026?
The last date to apply online is 28 October 2026.

tables: NTA UGC NET December 2026 : Apply Online Form

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the University Grant Commission UGC National Eligibility Test NET Assistant Professor / JRF December 2026 Examination online application Form 2026 will start from 08 October 2026 and the last date to apply will be 28 October 2026 . candidates should read the NTA UGC NET December 2026 information brochure for all the information related to the NET / JRF exam like syllabus, eligibility, age limit, fees, Subject Details, information and other types of information and then apply.
